title: Gateway Routing Pattern
description: Route client requests to multiple backend services through a single entry point. Express and NGINX gateway examples with correlation IDs, health checks, and a runnable Docker Compose demo.
description_es: Enruta solicitudes de clientes a múltiples servicios backend a través de un único punto de entrada. Ejemplos de gateway en Express y NGINX con IDs de correlación, health checks y demo ejecutable con Docker Compose.
